sections.Profile:
Rancho , released by Williams in 1977, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a Western theme. Designed by Harry Williams and Chris Otis, it includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, three drop targets, two kick-out holes, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Western, Original Theme, 1970s
